career_ladder.note: Executive Trainees and Ship Draftsman trainees at Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) progress through the technical shipbuilding hierarchy through annual performance evaluations, departmental proficiency reviews, and seniority.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Executive Trainee consists of two phases: Phase-I Online Test (Objective Type) and Phase-II Group Discussion, Writing Skills, and Personal Interview. Final selection is based on combined marks.

stages.stage_name: Phase I: Objective Type Online Test
stages.source_label: CSL Selection Process for Executive Trainees Notification

papers.paper_name: Part A: General Awareness, English Language, Numerical Ability & Reasoning Ability
Part B: Discipline Specific Technical Subject Knowledge

stages.stage_name: Phase II: GD, Writing Skills & Personal Interview

papers.paper_name: Group Discussion (GD: 10 marks), Writing Skills (10 marks) & Personal Interview (20 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 50% in Interview for General/EWS, 40% for Reserved

financial_package.note: Executive Trainees are placed in DPE IDA pay scale E-1 (₹40,000–₹1,40,000). During 1-year training, stipend equals basic pay ₹40,000 with mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, Kochi HRA, and cafeteria perks.
financial_package.pay_source_label: CSL Terms of Training and Service Conditions
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on Entry Basic Pay of ₹40,000, 58% IDA (₹23,200), Kochi Class Y HRA (18% = ₹7,200), and Cafeteria allowances (30% = ₹12,000), less statutory Contributory Provident Fund (12%) and medical scheme deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) with quarterly revision
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 18% in Kochi or company quarters
Cafeteria Approach Perks & Allowances up to 35% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on CSL annual corporate targets
Contributory Pension Scheme, Gratuity, and Group Insurance Scheme
Full medical coverage for self and eligible dependents at CSL Medical Centre

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment benchmarks from Cochin Shipyard Executive Trainee selection cycles.

years.source_label: CSL Notification P&A/2(263)/2024: 70 Executive Trainee vacancies across Naval Architecture, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil, and Instrumentation.
